events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 clinched the Premier League title with a 3–0 away win against 미들즈브러 on the season's final day, also clinching a place in the European Cup . Runners-up 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, who have gone without winning a league title since 1927 and had a 12-point lead in January, are held to a 1–1 draw at 토트넘 홋스퍼, who finish eighth and miss out on a UEFA Cup place. 리버풀 finish third and draw 2–2 at Maine Road with 맨체스터 시티, who are relegated on goal difference, while Coventry and 사우샘프턴 avoid the drop, both finishing the season with goalless draws. 리버풀 will compete in next season's Cup Winners' Cup, while fourth placed 애스턴 빌라 and fifth placed 아스널 will join 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in the UEFA Cup. Down in Division One, 밀월 are relegated five months after being top of the table, going down on the final day with 왓퍼드, while Luton's relegation was confirmed before the final game. Champions 선덜랜드 and runners-up 더비 카운티 have already secured automatic promotion, while 크리스털 팰리스, Stoke, 레스터 시티 and Charlton will contest the playoffs.
